faq.q: What does Fire & Smoke Restoration — Core Principles cover?
faq.a: Foundational fire and smoke restoration concepts for technicians working on residential and commercial smoke-affected properties.

faq.q: Which syllabus topics are listed for Fire & Smoke Restoration — Core Principles?
faq.a: Syllabus topics include Module 1 — Site safety & stabilisation; Module 2 — Smoke residue types; Module 3 — Surface cleaning mechanics; Module 4 — Contents vs structure workflow; Module 5 — Odour science overview; Module 6 — Equipment for air quality.
